items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Ralph Cooper, I remember one time was producing the black show at the Burbank Theater. Ralph Cooper was also from New York... But he was very popular and a very -- they say he was a very marvelous producer

ctx.x: That was -- was that the only -- that wasn't the only theater where they had live black entertainment. The Orpheum downtown had some black performers, didn't they?

Well, they would have some black entertainment, but at one time there was another theater. This was a burlesque theater. What is it? The Burbank. I think it's the Burbank Theater downtown. The Burbank at one time had their regular burlesque show and a black revue, you know. And Cooper -- what's his name? Ralph Cooper, I remember one time was producing the black show at the Burbank Theater. Ralph Cooper was also from New York, and I think Ralph is still around also. But he was very popular and a very -- they say…
About what year would this have been when they had the shows at the Burbank?
